published.source: Report re-sim on master abd7cd3, 2026-10-16: no level-based partial resist (#102) and the pass 23 rotations (#98 to #105) (was 674.9)

summary: Subtlety with Murder 2/2, for a Humanoid or Giant boss.
advantage: Murder 2/2 adds 4% damage against Humanoids and Giants. It does nothing against other bosses.
advantageShort: Murder 2/2 adds 4% damage against Humanoids and Giants.
rotation: Slice and Dice at 1+ combo points when down; refresh at 5 when about to drop
Cold Blood right before a 5-point Eviscerate; Thistle Tea at 10 energy or less
3-point Rupture when not ticking, with Hemorrhage right before it
Premeditation at 3 combo points or fewer (no Stealth needed)
Vanish into Ambush at 3 combo points or fewer, pooling energy; Preparation resets Vanish and Premeditation
consumes: Deadly Poison (main hand) and Instant Poison (off hand), each beside a Dense Sharpening Stone
caveats: Murder (+4% damage) only works against Humanoids and Giants.
The fight doesn't open from Stealth. Only Vanish gives Stealth.
Ghostly Strike adds nothing over Hemorrhage (0.5), but the build requires it.
Open: Premeditation out of Stealth and Preparation's reset list.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Backstab VIII, Eviscerate VIII, Deadly Poison IV). They would add 13 to 18.
Flask of Supreme Power and Greater Arcane Elixir left out (+8 through Dragonbreath Chili).
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as rogue__subtlety except talents, then the target's mobType set to MobTypeHumanoid, as the class preset's encounter does.
